notes.title: Deer Hunting Camp updates 09/25/2025
notes.content:
Latest update of 'Deer Hunting Camp' listing of changes/upgrades;
* fixed AI issues with rutting bucks during black powder		
* extended hunting area by moving boundary fences back		
* new trophy lodge to display buck harvests  (> 135 inches)			
* fixed a bug where trees sometimes failed to render in maps		
* additional maps for PS4/PS5						
* fix bug where dead deer react to grunting				
* modifications to bedded deer AI					
* allow the use of all firearms/archery tackle for any campaign hunt

notes.title: Deer Hunting Camp updates 7/24/2025
notes.content:
Latest update of 'Deer Hunting Camp' listing of changes/upgrades;

*  less frequency for buck grunting
*  fix deer from getting stuck in trees
*  fix deformity in 9 pointer antlers
*  more responsive mouse controls - (can be further adjusted in 'Customize' vert or horz sensitivity)

notes.title: Deer Hunting Camp updates 6/16/25
notes.content:
* PC keyboard diagram to include 'Q' key - toggles stalk mode for player walk
* Improved sighting optics for the 30-.06
* Fixed a bug where deer can come back to life on the gambrel
* Proper scaling for food plot area planted and adjusted objective metric as well
* Improved smoothing algorithm in map builder/terrain builder/modify terrain contours
* Provided a new hunting map in map builder - 'Saskatchewan'
